title: புனர்பூ தோஷம் - மண், பொன், காம ஆசைகள் (Punarphoo Yoga: Earth, Gold, Desires)
description: Saturn + Moon conjunction/aspect (Punarphoo) is not always destructive; it stimulates ambitions: Land/Property in Mars/Mercury signs, Wealth/Gold in Jupiter/Venus signs, Romance in Mercury/Venus signs.

title: சந்திர மங்கள யோகம் (Chandra-Mangala Yoga)
description: Moon and Mars in strong mutual connection during Dasa/Bhukti brings puberty in girls, purchase/construction of homes, and motherhood.

title: காலப் பொழுது - நிகழ்வு நேரம் அறிதல் (Event Timing: Morning, Afternoon, Evening)
description: Rasi timing chart determines whether an event (good or bad) transpires during morning, noon, evening, or night, and whether in early, middle, or final part of Dasa/Bhukti.

source.section: ஒரு செயல் எப்போது நிகழும் என்பதை அறிய உதவும்
